title: The Ash-Silk Doorway
story: In the smoky Library of Lastlight, Emberweaver the Ash Spider has sealed the reading-room door with 63 feet of gray ash-silk, trapping six little librarian gnomes inside with their beloved books. She perches above the doorway spinning more silk even as Mr 6 slashes at it, cackling that no knight can unweave faster than she can weave. Mr 6 sheathes his sword, does the arithmetic on a dusty index card, and smiles.
question: Mr 6 unravels 6 feet of ash-silk every minute, while Emberweaver spins 4.5 new feet every minute onto the same 63-foot web. How many minutes until the doorway is completely clear?
hint: Each minute, how much silk actually disappears? Subtract what she adds from what he removes to find the real progress per minute.
victory: After 42 patient minutes the last thread puffs into ash, and Emberweaver — outmathed, not outmuscled — retires to spin bookmarks for the grateful gnomes.
imagePrompt: A brave numeral-six knight with a blue cape calmly unraveling a glowing gray web across a tall library doorway while a huge ash-colored spider spins above him, warm lantern light cutting through drifting smoke and towering bookshelves.
solution: Each minute the web really shrinks by 6 - 4.5 = 1.5 feet.
Divide the web by that real progress: 63 / 1.5 = 42.
The doorway is completely clear after 42 minutes.
praise: Dividing the 63 feet was the right instinct — the missing step was subtracting her 4.5 feet first to get the real progress.
